questions.question: Which type of cartilage forms the intervertebral discs?
questions.explanation: Intervertebral discs are made of fibrocartilage, which is tough and resists compression.

questions.question: Which cells break down (resorb) bone tissue?
questions.explanation: Osteoclasts resorb bone; osteoblasts build new bone.

questions.question: What is the structural unit of compact bone?
questions.explanation: Compact bone is built from osteons, each with a central Haversian canal.
